project.name: black-oak-referral-program
project.productType: digital studio marketing and operations website

must: Preserve the black and gold BLVCK OAK identity
Preserve existing responsive shelves, navigation, forms and tree animation
Keep decorative motion optional and compatible with reduced motion, touch and forced colours
avoid: Introducing a framework runtime for a single decorative effect
Non-brand glow colours or effects that reduce text contrast

decisions.name: Gold spotlight card treatment
decisions.decision: Adapt the supplied GlowCard interaction to the homepage package cards through the existing future-ui card layer, using a soft gold interior light and a brighter one-pixel border trace.
decisions.rationale: The native implementation reuses BLVCK OAK's frame-throttled pointer system, brand tokens and accessibility controls without adding React, Tailwind or duplicate listeners.
